answer: New keys must burn, not recycle a lock. An operator burns 800 POA onto a public zenith board (the posted burn roll) and then waits 12 epochs in a canyon, a narrow admission lane, before earning. Each epoch the key must emit a live echo to a random auditor in 60 seconds. A missed or copied echo bans the key 20 epochs with no refund. Honest cost: 800 POA gone plus 12 dark epochs. 1,000 clones spend 800,000 POA irreversibly and sit idle 12 rounds, vs ~160 POA farmed. Hole: shared wallets recycling one burn; bind each burn to one key at payment and exile co-funded keys together.
